panels.description: Today's America/New_York Neon commitment spend vs daily cap, read from ingest_state (evaluated by llm-ledger commitment-spend feed). Green below $1,125 (75%), yellow $1,125-$1,500, red at or above $1,500 daily cap. Stale feed (>15 min) or past day_end_ms evaluates complete to Incomplete and spend to NULL.

targets.queryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_usd' THEN value END) AS spend_raw,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_daily_cap_usd' THEN value END) AS cap_raw,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_requests' THEN value END) AS req_raw,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_complete' THEN value END) AS complete_raw,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_day_end_ms' THEN value END) AS day_end_ms_raw,
    MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_updated_at' THEN value END) AS updated_at_raw
  FROM ingest_state
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(spend_raw AS REAL) AS spend,
    COALESCE(CAST(cap_raw AS REAL), 1500.0) AS cap,
    CAST(req_raw AS INTEGER) AS requests,
    COALESCE(CAST(complete_raw AS INTEGER), 0) AS complete,
    CAST(day_end_ms_raw AS INTEGER) AS day_end_ms,
    updated_at_raw AS updated_at,
    CASE
      WHEN updated_at_raw IS NOT NULL
      THEN ROUND((julianday('now') - julianday(updated_at_raw)) * 1440.0, 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS feed_age_min,
    CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS now_ms
  FROM raw
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN day_end_ms IS NULL OR now_ms >= day_end_ms THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(spend, 0.0)
  END AS "Today's Neon Spend",
  cap AS "Daily Cap",
  CASE
    WHEN day_end_ms IS NULL OR now_ms >= day_end_ms OR spend IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * spend / NULLIF(cap, 0), 1)
  END AS "% of Cap",
  CASE
    WHEN day_end_ms IS NULL OR now_ms >= day_end_ms THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(requests, 0)
  END AS "Requests Today",
  CAST(CASE
    WHEN day_end_ms IS NULL OR now_ms >= day_end_ms THEN 0
    WHEN feed_age_min IS NULL OR feed_age_min > 15.0 THEN 0
    ELSE complete
  END AS INTEGER) AS "Feed Complete",
  feed_age_min AS "Feed Age (min)"
FROM parsed

panels.description: Fleet mix across interactive sessions (goose and opencode) for the selected range and program filter. Covers cloudbox (hourly) because remote hosts only export fleet:<host> aggregates. Note: Sessions using both Opus and Neon in the window are counted in both model buckets.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN h.attr_key END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' OR substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN h.attr_key END), 0), 1) AS "% Goose (sessions)",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN h.attr_key END), 0), 1) AS "% Neon of Goose (sessions)",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Neon sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Opus sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Opencode Opus sessions"
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})

panels.description: Active unique sessions per hour bucketed by time interval, broken down by harness and model family. Covers cloudbox (hourly) because remote hosts only export fleet:<host> aggregates. Note: Sessions using both Opus and Neon in the window are counted in both model buckets.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  (h.hour / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'goose / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'goose / opus'
    WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'opencode / opus'
    WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'opencode / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / opus'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN 'goose / other'
    WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN 'opencode / other'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / other'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS series,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.attr_key) AS Value
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Per-program adoption breakdown: Goose Neon sessions, Goose Opus sessions, Opencode sessions, and spend by model. Covers cloudbox (hourly) because remote hosts only export fleet:<host> aggregates.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') AS "Program",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Neon sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Opus sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Opencode sessions",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Neon $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Opus $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Opencode $",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN h.attr_key END), 0), 1) AS "Neon % of Goose"
FROM hourly h

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') AS "Program",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Neon sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Opus sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Opencode sessions",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Neon $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Opus $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(h.attr_key, 1, 4) = 'ses_' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Opencode $",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN h.attr_key END), 0), 1) AS "Neon % of Goose"
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Goose Neon $" DESC, "Goose Opus $" DESC
